name: ts-pro
description: TypeScript coding, code review and vibe coding with low technical debt: one source of truth, native Node.js first, visible exceptions.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: Show the ts-pro controls above the prompt: git level, pause staging, writing tests and the work modes.

git_level.title: Git level
git_level.description: How far Claude may take its work in git. Commands above this level are blocked.

pause_staging.title: Pause staging
pause_staging.description: Block staging, commits and pushes for now, so you can compare changes in the working tree.

write_tests.title: Writing tests
write_tests.description: Whether Claude writes tests for what it adds or changes. When off, existing tests still run.

issue_source.title: Issue source
issue_source.description: Where find-issues and autonomous mode read and file issues.

issues_folder.title: Issues folder
issues_folder.description: Folder of issue files, relative to the project root. Used when the issue source is folder.

max_auto_tasks.title: Autonomous task limit
max_auto_tasks.description: Autonomous mode stops after this many tasks.
